article_title: Questions mount over what an AI 'slowdown' would look like

tasks.prompt: What is the article's main argument about calls for an AI slowdown?
options: A slowdown is already clearly defined and accepted
AI companies have stopped competing with China
The proposal answers fears but raises unresolved practical, economic and political questions
British policy no longer depends on AI
tasks.correct_answer: The proposal answers fears but raises unresolved practical, economic and political questions
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מדגישה שאין עדיין הגדרה מעשית מוסכמת להאטה ושיישומה כרוך באכיפה, אמון, תחרות וכלכלה.

tasks.prompt: Who publicly agreed with Dario Amodei's call to slow AI development?
options: Ed Zitron and Alexander Voica
President Trump and Parker Thayer
Sasha Luccioni and Wendy Hall
Sam Altman and Elon Musk
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שסם אלטמן ואילון מאסק, מחברות מתחרות, הסכימו עם אמודיי.

tasks.prompt: What does Ed Zitron imply by saying AI products could be “captured in amber”?
options: They could remain frozen at their current stage while rivals improve
They could be protected from every cyber threat
They could be sold at a higher price
They could become transparent to monitors
tasks.correct_answer: They could remain frozen at their current stage while rivals improve
tasks.explanation_hebrew: captured in amber הוא דימוי לשימור במצב קפוא בזמן שמעבדות מתחרות ממשיכות לפתח.

tasks.prompt: Which measures are included in Amodei's three-point plan?
options: An investment ban, fewer NHS projects and voluntary promises
Independent monitoring, industry-wide regulation and global regulation
National control and an end to model training
Open-source publication, lower prices and university limits
tasks.correct_answer: Independent monitoring, industry-wide regulation and global regulation
tasks.explanation_hebrew: שלושת המרכיבים הם ניטור עצמאי בזמן הפיתוח, רגולציה כלל־תעשייתית ורגולציה עולמית.

tasks.prompt: Why would enforcing a slowdown require an unusually high level of trust?
options: Governments must disclose military information
China must stop all technology exports
Regulators may depend on firms revealing what they do and choose not to do
Investors must guarantee every company becomes profitable
tasks.correct_answer: Regulators may depend on firms revealing what they do and choose not to do
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בלי מנגנון ברור, הפיקוח עשוי להסתמך על שקיפות החברות לגבי מה שהן מפתחות וגם מה שאינן עושות.

tasks.prompt: What are AI “guardrails” in Professor Wendy Hall's argument?
options: Financial returns for investors
Physical fences around data centres
Systems that speed up training
Safety rules and protections intended to prevent harmful behaviour
tasks.correct_answer: Safety rules and protections intended to prevent harmful behaviour
tasks.explanation_hebrew: guardrails הם מעקי בטיחות מטפוריים — כללים והגנות שנועדו למנוע נזק.

tasks.prompt: Identify the main international and enforcement obstacles to an AI slowdown.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את מרוץ ארה״ב–סין, החשש להישאר מאחור, הגוף המפקח, שקיפות ואמון.
expected_points: The US fears losing to China
Companies expect rivals to continue if they pause
Nobody wants to slow first
It is unclear who would police the slowdown
The term has not been defined substantively
Enforcement may depend on corporate transparency and trust

tasks.prompt: Analyse the economic case both for and against slowing AI development in the UK.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את חשיבות AI לצמיחה ולשירותים מול עלויות, הכנסות חלשות, סכנת בועה ורגולציה.
expected_points: AI is central to the UK's growth strategy and planned NHS use
A slowdown could harm investment and useful adoption
The industry consumes enormous money and resources
Revenue remains far below spending
A market correction may occur anyway
Power could concentrate in surviving firms
Poorly timed regulation might backfire
A slowdown may improve safety and trust

tasks.prompt: Summarise the competing views about whether and how AI development should be slowed.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את אזהרות הבטיחות, התוכנית, קשיי האכיפה והתחרות והוויכוח הכלכלי.
expected_points: AI leaders and a former researcher express serious concern
Amodei proposes monitoring and coordinated regulation
Critics say slowdown lacks a practical definition
Competition with China makes unilateral action unlikely
The UK expects AI to support services and growth
Some focus on corporate greed and weak safety protections
Others fear premature or politically motivated over-regulation

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced policy proposal defining an enforceable AI slowdown while addressing the article's objections.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להגדיר באנגלית האטה מעשית, ניטור, אכיפה, תיאום בינלאומי, שימושים מועילים ומדדי בחינה.
expected_points: Define which training or capability advances are slowed
Name an independent monitor
Require verifiable reporting
Set common industry rules
Coordinate internationally, including the US and China
Protect beneficial uses
Assess economic and environmental costs
Prevent rules favouring only large firms
Set safety benchmarks, penalties and a review date
